title: Happy Days Are Here Again

evidence.note: Described as a 1929 song, originally published by Ager, Yellen and Bornstein. The page states its copyright was renewed in 1956, so it entered the US public domain on January 1, 2025.

famous_use: Campaign song of Franklin D. Roosevelt's 1932 presidential campaign; first heard in the film Chasing Rainbows (1930).
